verdict.line: You lose this lane if you facetank his Q/E chip and let Darkness Rise proc for free; you win if you stun-into-dash the instant his W (Indestructible) is down and ride the 53.7% win rate into a longer fight.

brief.thesis: Irelia holds a real edge here (53.7% over 365 games, lane advantage hers, solo-kills even) because her E-stun into Q-dash resets generate more fast exchanges than Mordekaiser can answer with a single 675-range Q and an 8-second-minimum W cycle. The catch is his Passive, Darkness Rise: land three hits on him and he gets a damage aura plus Move Speed mid-trade, which is what turns an even skirmish into a losing one. Play the fight around his cooldowns, not his health bar.

theirWindow.what: He's landed three hits on you and now carries a damage aura and bonus Move Speed - stop trading immediately. Bladesurge (Q) onto a minion to put distance between you rather than continuing to auto or charge W through his empowered hits.

yourWindow.what: His shield generator is on cooldown (12s at rank 1, down to 8s at rank 5) so your damage isn't getting banked and healed back. If you're also sitting on 4 stacks of Ionian Fervor (Passive) from hitting minions, open with E (Flawless Duet) for the stun and Mark, dash in with Q (Bladesurge) for the reset and heal, then unload autos while the bonus on-hit damage holds.

start.why: Highest pick rate start at 82.3% and 53% win rate over 381 games - the extra AD and sustain let you win the short trades your E-stun combo sets up.

boots.why: Runs 67.9% pick, 51.6% win rate over 287 games. Mordekaiser's entire kit (Q, E, R) is magic damage, so the magic resist directly blunts every poke and pull he throws at you.

core.why: First item on the top path (70.1% win rate over 67 games) - the on-hit damage scales your stun-into-dash trades and the slow keeps him from walking off after Death's Grasp misses.
Second in that same 70.1%-win-rate path - snowballs sidelane pressure once you're already winning the 1v1s.
Closes out the core build - magic resist stacks directly counter his all-magic-damage kit while adding more attack speed for your Passive stacks.

runes.keystoneWhy: Conqueror stacks fastest in the repeated short trades your maxed Q and E-into-Q strings create, and the adaptive healing offsets his Q chip damage as long as you're not standing still long enough to feed his Passive's third hit.

summoners.why: The standard pick at 87.1% pick rate and 53.5% win rate. Ignite punishes his W (Indestructible) shield-into-heal cycle during your all-in window, while Flash guarantees you land the E-stun range or escape a Death's Grasp pull.

playing.title: Don't feed his passive with autos
playing.detail: Avoid trading autos into him when you don't need to - every hit he lands on you counts toward the three needed for Darkness Rise. Let him waste Obliterate (Q, 8s cooldown at rank 1) on minions instead.

playing.title: Bait Death's Grasp before committing
playing.detail: His E pulls enemies in an area and is his main engage/peel tool, sitting at 16s cooldown early down to 8s by rank 5. Make him spend it on a minion wave or whiff it before you commit your all-in.

playing.title: Stack passive off the wave first
playing.detail: Hit minions with Q and W to build Ionian Fervor (Passive) attack speed stacks before you engage, so you're already at 4 stacks and carrying the bonus on-hit damage into the trade.

playing.title: Open fights with E, not Q
playing.detail: Lead with E (Flawless Duet) for the stun and Mark, then Bladesurge (Q) onto the marked target for the free cooldown refresh and heal - opening with Q into a full-health Mordekaiser wastes the reset.

playing.title: Track his W before you dive
playing.detail: Indestructible (W) banks damage into a shield he can consume to heal. If he just cast it, your damage in the next 8-12 seconds isn't getting absorbed - that's your green light to commit.

playing.title: Break off the instant his passive procs
playing.detail: The moment his third hit lands and Darkness Rise triggers, disengage with Q onto a minion rather than trading through his empowered damage and Move Speed bonus.

playing.title: Respect his ult from level 6 on
playing.detail: Realm of Death is a long-cooldown (140/120/100/90/80s) duel reset that can flip a losing fight in his favor. Don't overextend after a trade near level 6+ until you've confirmed he's used it.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, and all win rate/pick rate figures are measured from live games on the current patch via OP.GG; the tell, power curve, and trade-pattern reasoning are my own read of the ability interactions.
